SELECT * FROM departments WHERE is_active = 1
AND departments.id = #{filter.departmentId} AND id IN (SELECT department_id FROM employees WHERE is_active = 1)
AND id IN (SELECT department_id FROM user_departments WHERE user_id = #{userId}) AND group_id = #{filter.groupId}

SELECT *, employee_code AS empId, gender AS gender, name_kh AS nameKh, name_en AS nameEn, paid_by AS paidType, (SELECT name FROM positions WHERE id = position_id) AS positionName, (SELECT ordering FROM positions WHERE id = position_id) AS positionOrdering, DATE_FORMAT(start_working_date, "%d-%b-%Y") AS dateOfWork, (SELECT old_salary FROM payrolls WHERE is_active = 1 AND employee_id = employees.id AND MONTH(pay_date) = MONTH(#{payDate}) AND YEAR(pay_date) = YEAR(#{payDate})) AS currentSalary, (SELECT increase_salary FROM payrolls WHERE is_active = 1 AND employee_id = employees.id AND MONTH(pay_date) = MONTH(#{payDate}) AND YEAR(pay_date) = YEAR(#{payDate})) AS increaseSalary, (SELECT total_amount FROM payrolls WHERE is_active = 1 AND employee_id = employees.id AND MONTH(pay_date) = MONTH(#{payDate}) AND YEAR(pay_date) = YEAR(#{payDate})) AS totalAmount, (SELECT note FROM payrolls WHERE is_active = 1 AND employee_id = employees.id AND MONTH(pay_date) = MONTH(#{payDate}) AND YEAR(pay_date) = YEAR(#{payDate})) AS note FROM employees WHERE is_active = 1 AND department_id = #{departmentId} AND id IN ( SELECT employee_id FROM payrolls WHERE is_active = 1 AND MONTH(pay_date) = MONTH(#{payDate}) AND YEAR(pay_date) = YEAR(#{payDate}) ) AND ( employees.id IN ( SELECT employee_id FROM employee_apply_status AS eas WHERE eas.is_active = 1 AND eas.employee_status_id NOT IN(4,5,6) ) OR employees.id IN( SELECT employee_id FROM employee_apply_status AS eas WHERE eas.is_active = 1 AND eas.employee_status_id IN (4,5,6) AND MONTH(eas.date) > MONTH(#{payDate}) AND YEAR(eas.date) >= YEAR(#{payDate}) ) OR id IN ( SELECT employee_id FROM payrolls WHERE is_active = 1 AND employee_id = employees.id AND MONTH(pay_date) = MONTH(#{payDate}) AND YEAR(pay_date) = YEAR(#{payDate}) ) ) AND employees.id IN ( SELECT employee_id FROM employee_apply_status AS eas WHERE eas.is_active = 1 ) ORDER BY positionOrdering ASC
SELECT * FROM payroll_item_types WHERE is_active = 1 ORDER BY id DESC

SELECT amount FROM payroll_details WHERE is_active = 1 AND payroll_item_id = #{payrollItemId} AND payroll_id IN (SELECT id FROM payrolls WHERE is_active = 1 AND employee_id = #{employeesId} AND MONTH(pay_date) = MONTH(#{payDate}) AND YEAR(pay_date) = YEAR(#{payDate}))
